tool.name: IMAGINE-X SubHKL Diffraction Parallax
tool.description: Interactive Laue zone & Lattice-Ladder solve explorer with local-staging GPU execution
tool.command: umask 0000 && export CUDA_CACHE_PATH=/tmp/cuda_cache XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/xdg_cache XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/xdg_config && trap 'rc=\$?; chmod -R a+rwX "\$PWD" \${_GALAXY_JOB_HOME_DIR:+"\$_GALAXY_JOB_HOME_DIR"} \${_GALAXY_JOB_TMP_DIR:+"\$_GALAXY_JOB_TMP_DIR"} 2>/dev/null || true; exit \$rc' EXIT && mkdir -p "\$PWD/subhkl_staging" && chmod 0777 "\$PWD/subhkl_staging" && export TMPDIR="\$PWD/subhkl_staging" SUBHKL_STAGING_DIR="\$PWD/subhkl_staging" && export SUBHKL_EXEC_MODE=local JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false && #set $p_opt = "" #if $indexed_h5: ln -sf "$indexed_h5" input_peaks.h5 && #set $p_opt = "--peaks input_peaks.h5" #end if #set $img_opt = "" #if $images_h5: ln -sf "$images_h5" input_images.h5 && #set $img_opt = "--images input_images.h5" #end if subhkl-nova-app $p_opt $img_opt --instrument "$instrument" --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8081 --server timeout=0 > >(tee -a $output) 2> >(tee -a $output >&2)

param.name: indexed_h5
param.label: Solved / Indexed / Integrated SubHKL HDF5 (solve.h5, indexer.h5, integrator.h5)

tool.help: Starts the interactive NOVA Trame user interface for IMAGINE-X SubHKL Diffraction Parallax and Lattice-Ladder workflow orchestration.
